pr_title: dfu/mcuboot: removes BOOT_MAX_ALIGN and BOOT_MAGIC_SZ definition copies
pr_body:
Mcuboot bootutil_public.h provides theses original definitions.
This patch includes bootutil_public.h in places where origina definitions are needed.
Thanks to that there is no need to copy then any more.

fixes #50342
pr_comments:
can you please fix the compliance failure?

> 1: T4 Title contains hard tab characters (\t): "include/dfu/mcuboot: BOOT_MAX_ALIGN	defined condioally"

issue_context.title: mcuboot: BOOT_MAX_ALIGN is redefined
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

**To Reproduce**

```
scripts/twister -v -N -M -p nucleo_h753zi -s samples/subsys/usb/dfu/sample.usb.dfu
```

**Expected behavior**

`BOOT_MAX_ALIGN` is only defined once.

**Impact**
